profile.headline: Senior Developer / Business Analyst
profile.summary:
Seeking opportunity to bring 10+ years of experience in software development and support to a software-related engineering or management position while continuing full stack education

Skills:
•	Programming: C#/.Net, Java, Microsoft SQL, PowerShell
•	Integration: Imports, exports, file parsers, server jobs and 3rd party integration
•	Server: Create/manage scheduled tasks, services, and utilize PowerShell for automation
•	Applications: Visual Studio, VS Code, Azure Data Studio & Profiler, IntelliJ

positions.title: Software Developer / Business Analyst
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• .NET Rest-API and MS SQL Development
• ETL & Reporting for Enterprise applications

positions.title: Software Developer / Support / Business Analyst
positions.description:
• Java Rest-API endpoints and DB structure for new applications
• Create integration solutions for Enterprise applications
• Powershell: Develop automated jobs for remote devices
• SSRS reports and ETL using MS Technologies
• Agile: Refine and validate acceptance criteria and document tickets

positions.title: Application Support Analyst
positions.description:
•	Tier 2/3 Support - Troubleshoot customer application functionality and performance
•	C++/SQL/Java - Update source code in various branches of the software
•	Merge code into older releases to support legacy-versioned customers
•	Mentored NC State University interns for Tier 2/3 level support

positions.title: Application Support Analyst
positions.description:
• Maintain Enterprise applications supporting major business functions 
• PowerShell/Java - Develop scripts to automate business processes
• VBA - Designed PCI compliance tool and Outlook attachment extractor
• 24x7 on-call software/hardware support – Microsoft Windows & Unix Servers
• Microsoft SharePoint - Constructed intranet web portal for IT Department

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration
